ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 22-E
in the area bound by:

      the south right-of-way line of The Chicago, Rock Island, and Pacific Railroad; the west
      right-of-way line of The Illinois Central Railroad; East 95th Street; South Cottage Grove
      Avenue; South Burnside Avenue; and a line 141.4 feet west of the intersection of South
      Cottage Grove Avenue and South Burnside Avenue as measured along the north right-
      of-way line of South Burnside Avenue,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ___________________________
                                                          Michelle Harris
                                                          Alderman, 8th Ward




Common Address:
9449-9465 S. Cottage Grove
9445 S. Burnside Avenue
